description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a cloud resource belongs
description_zh: 修改云资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp move-resource-group --resource-id ddos_originpre_public_cn-7213kxxxxx --resource-group-id 'rg-acfm3peow3k****' --resource-type instance --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud resource instance whose resource group you want to change
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改资源组的云资源的实例 ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the cloud resource instance. You can call the ListResourceGroups operation of Resource Management to query the resource groups under the current account and obtain the resource group ID. Anti-DDoS Origin does not provide an operation to query resource groups
parameters.help_zh: 需要移入云资源实例的资源组 ID。您可以调用资源管理的 ListResourceGroups 接口，查询当前账号下的资源组列表并获取资源组 ID；DDoS 原生防护不提供查询资源组列表的接口
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the cloud resource whose resource group you want to change. Valid values: instance
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改资源组的云资源类型，取值：instance
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The region where the resource resides
parameters.name: resource_region_id
